newsitem.title: USA: Big City Bagels to lower warrant exercise prices.
newsitem.headline: Big City Bagels to lower warrant exercise prices.

text.p: Big City Bagels Inc said Monday that it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to reduce the exercise price of its Class A warrants to $2.50 per share, from $4.50 per share for 90 days. The company has an option to extend the period another 30 days.

The company also said that it will change the exercise terms of its Class B warrants, reducing their exercise price to $2.50 per share, and allowing holders to purchase one share of common stock for each Class B warrant.
Previously Class B warrantholders required two such warrants to be exercised in tandem with an aggregate exercise price of $8 per share of common stock.
The company said there were certain other conditions attached to the change in exercise price.
